instruction: Claude Mods page layer (2026-10-15, user requests: a tidier Mods options page with every option checked, and the untranslated Windows message boxes). Codex must never run publish_mods*.py --restore or otherwise remove the Mods page layer: KR_MD* functions; C_ConfigView@EventConfAsraDataForParts / EventConfPartsDataForAsra call KR_MDSeenToParts / KR_MDSeenToAsra where they called KR_ANCfgSeenToParts / KR_ANCfgSeenToAsra (the auto-nav functions are called first, their result returned); the S_PUSH operands of 42 system.MsgBox* / system.Error texts point to CP949 strings (Windows shows MessageBoxA text in the system code page, so the Japanese CP932 and the FNL-proxy Korean showed as garbage); PACT 185 Asra/Mods and 187 Asra/AutoItems laid out again with the KR_MD_* parts (slider tracks, headings, tags, ticks). It is user-requested: when a rebuild needs a clean base, rebase on the runtime that current.json points to and carry it forward; restore is reserved for the user's explicit request. Payload: NightRemaster.ain + NightRemasterPact.afa (entries 185 and 187 only). KR_MD* functions appended; no original function relocated; no new global / struct member. PACT 185 / 187 are laid out by mods_tab_20261015/build_pact_mods.py: every part name code or the EX table Ｅ＿コンフィグファイル名 looks up is kept; later edits of these entries start from the installed entries, not from an older build. Message-box texts (system.MsgBox* / system.Error) stay CP949 bytes; never write them with FNL proxy characters. While the options are open the home 달성률 panel (KR_HomeRate) is hidden by KR_MDHomeRate (KR_RateRender's own ■コンフィグ実行中確認 = Ｓ＿コンフィグ on the stack misses the home path ▲コンフィグ実行 -> Ｓ＿コンフィグ／標準 / ／開始ページ); the home loop shows it again. The auto-nav pins stay (index, address and every code byte): KR_AN_E00058, KR_AN_E00063, KR_AN_E00069, KR_AN_E00104, KR_AN_E00258, KR_AN_E00260, KR_AN_E00322, KR_AN_E00611, KR_AN_E10021, KR_AN_E20041, KR_AN_E20081, KR_AN_E20164, KR_AN_E30001, KR_AN_E30021, KR_AN_E30152, KR_AN_E40021, KR_AN_E40041, KR_AN_E40043, KR_AN_E40061, KR_ANSelect, KR_ANSelFrame, KR_ANTrainConfirm, KR_ANOpeningQ, KR_ANNewGame. <runtime>/KRMenu/ is the temporary exchange-file folder of the mod-menu hook and the game script (request.txt, last_result.txt, reset.req, restore.req): never put it in a manifest, ignore it in every tree check, and never delete it (a pending reset.req / restore.req or an unread last_result.txt may be waiting there). Every earlier contract stays in force.
